description: Loader assemblies the distributable compiles against, pinned to the oldest supported Unity Mod Manager instead of whichever loader is installed locally. A tracked product input: changing it changes the source state and invalidates existing build receipts. Each file is fetched from its upstream source into artifacts/references/loader, verified by SHA-256 and never committed, bundled or packaged. Info.json ManagerVersion must equal minimumManagerVersion.

references.source: newman55/unity-mod-manager lib/Harmony/1.2 at the 0.31.1 commit 10cfb1cc; byte-identical in UMM 0.31.1, 0.32.4 and 0.33.0
